name: Personalized Picture Frame Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality stainless steel and double glass, offering a sleek, durable, and elegant finish for personalized display.
    - Includes 2 custom printed inserts on 300 GSM glossy paper, providing a smooth surface, sharp detail, and a polished presentation.
    - Designed with a delicate hanging chain for easy ornament display on walls, hooks, trees, or decorative stands.
    - Features a secure side latch that helps keep the frame closed while allowing easy opening when needed.
    - Built with a slim yet sturdy 0.7 cm thickness, giving the ornament a refined and lightweight feel.
    - Comes in both horizontal and vertical display formats to suit different photo orientations.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Frame size:
               +) Vertical format: 6.4 x 8.8 cm ~ 2.52 x 3.46 in
               +) Horizontal format: 8.8 x 6.4 cm ~ 3.46 x 2.52 in
    - Displayed Image Size:
               +) Horizontal photo size: 8.4 x 5.8 cm ~ 3.3 x 2.28 in
               +) Vertical photo size: 5.8 x 8.4 cm ~ 2.28 x 3.3 in
    📌 Note:  The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality digital printing to ensure sharp, vibrant, and long-lasting colors.
    - Displayed image printed on one side.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a photo frame ornament and a personalized decorative keepsake.
    - Suitable for displaying family photos, wedding memories, house illustrations, couple portraits, and meaningful printed artwork.
    - Great for home décor, holiday ornaments, memorial keepsakes, gift displays, and special event decorations.
    - Lightweight and easy to hang in different indoor settings.
    - Designed for both decorative presentation and sentimental value.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for couples, families, parents, newlyweds, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for weddings, anniversaries, housewarmings, Christmas, memorial keepsakes, birthdays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves meaningful custom décor and photo keepsakes.
    - Great as a holiday ornament, home accent, or sentimental display gift.
    - A beautiful gift choice that combines elegance, memory, and personalized charm 🎁

 

  • Easy to Use:
    - Slide open the small side clips.
    - Open the two hinged glass panels.
    - Place the pressed item or printed image into the frame.
    - Close and display the ornament for a more attractive finished look.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Personalized Picture Frame Ornament

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
